title: How do I learn to code for free?
problem_statement: You want to learn programming or web development but can't pay for courses.
expected_outcome: A steady learning routine and your first finished coding projects.

steps.title: Pick a goal
steps.instructions: Decide why you're learning (for example, building websites or analysing data). This decides your first language.

steps.title: Start a structured free curriculum
steps.instructions: Begin freeCodeCamp's first course and follow it in order.

steps.title: Schedule practice
steps.instructions: Book short, regular study sessions (for example, 30 minutes on five days a week).

steps.title: Build and share projects
steps.instructions: Complete the course projects yourself and keep them in a portfolio.
steps.expected_result: At least one finished project you can show.

quality_checks: You can explain what each line of your project does.
You have finished at least one project without copying a solution.

editorial.author: V2 research pass (AI-assisted, Claude)
